title: scoringProfile is a hand-typed label, not a fact about scoring: dynasty_main and dynasty_new carry the same string while their host scoring differs on 35 of 48 shared keys, so /api/data serves dynasty_main's board verbatim for dynasty_new
claimUnderTest: CLAUDE.md: 'Two leagues that use identical scoring share ONE ranking pipeline and ONE output... 503 data_not_ready only fires when the scoring profiles genuinely differ.' src/api/league_registry.py:480 calls scoringProfile 'the identifier for which set of rules produces this league's player values'.
observed: scoringProfile is an opaque free-text field parsed at league_registry.py:144 and never validated against any scoring_settings. Both registry entries carry "superflex_tep15_ppr1". The live host says the two leagues share only 48 scoring keys and DISAGREE on 35 of them (rec 0.08 vs 1.0, pass_td 6.0 vs 4.0, pass_yd 1/30 vs 1/25, pass_int -4.0 vs -1.0, fum_lost -4.0 vs -2.0, bonus_rec_te 0.0 vs 0.5), plus 48 nonzero keys exist only in dynasty_main (the entire IDP card, first-down bonuses, completion/incompletion scoring, reception-distance bonuses). server.py:3076 compares the two label strings, they match, the 503 never fires, and GET /api/data?leagueKey=dynasty_new returns the dynasty_main board with rankDerivedValue identical on 1092 of 1092 rows. The only test that touches the field (tests/api/test_config_parity.py:199) asserts the string is non-empty and not literally "default".

reproduction.expected: either a 503 data_not_ready for dynasty_new, or a board computed under dynasty_new's own 48-key full-PPR non-IDP scoring
reproduction.actual: HTTP 200, identical rankDerivedValue on 1092/1092 rows, meta.scoringProfile "superflex_tep15_ppr1"

numericProof.formula: count(k in shared : main[k] != new[k]) ; count(rows : rankDerivedValue_main == rankDerivedValue_new)

userImpact: A user who switches to 'Blood, Sweat, and Beers' in the LeagueSwitcher sees a full-PPR, no-IDP, 4-pt-passing-TD league priced with a 0.08-PPR IDP superflex board. Every trade value, every rank, every tier on /rankings and /trade is computed under the wrong league's rules, and nothing on the page says so.

priorFinding.note: Adjacent to PRIOR-A20-F04 (TE++ basis wrong for dynasty_new) but that finding assumes the shared-profile premise; this one refutes the premise itself.

whatWorks: The 503 gate and the leagues_share_scoring helper are correctly wired and would fire if the labels differed; the mechanism is sound and only its input is unverified.
rootCause: scoringProfile is authored by hand in registry.json with no derivation from, or check against, the league's actual scoring_settings. src/league_comparison/sleeper_scoring.py already computes a content hash of a scoring dict (_scoring_hash, sha1[:12]) — the registry does not use it.
requiredRepair: Derive the profile identity from a content hash of the league's live scoring_settings (the mechanism already exists in sleeper_scoring._scoring_hash), or add a startup/CI check that every pair of leagues sharing a scoringProfile has byte-identical scoring_settings. Until then dynasty_new must get its own profile string.
dependencies: Requires one read-only GET per league to api.sleeper.app, which config.py::fetch_live_league already does.
